title: 2018 Score #15 Alex Smith NFL Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2018 Score card features Alex Smith, the quarterback for the Washington Commanders, in his Signal Callers uniform. It is a sports trading card manufactured by Panini and is part of the 2018 Score set. The card number is 15 and it is an insert card from the Signal Callers insert set.

This card is perfect for collectors who are fans of the National Football League (NFL) and enjoy collecting sports trading cards. It is a great addition to any collection and would make a perfect gift for someone who loves football. Get your hands on this rare insert card today!
